A curated list of **OSINT** tools & resources.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A heavily curated directory of OSINT tools and intelligence resources covering domains from aviation tracking to dark web analysis.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Legendary OSINT is a comprehensive, structured directory that aggregates third-party Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) tools and databases. Instead of being a software application, it acts as a categorized intelligence repository sourced from newsletters, Telegram groups, and public collections. The repository categorizes specific investigative workflows, offering dedicated lists for tracking aviation and maritime movements, analyzing malware, mapping geospatial data, and investigating corporate intelligence. It serves as a centralized jumping-off point for threat intelligence analysts and fraud investigators needing verified, categorized links for deep-dive investigations.
keyFeatures: Categorized Intelligence Index: Organizes resources into logical domains like people search, maritime movements, and business intelligence.
Cross-Domain OSINT Coverage: Spans multiple disciplines including cyber threat intelligence (CTI), fraud investigation, and physical infrastructure tracking.
Curated Sourcing: Aggregates hard-to-find tools from niche communities, newsletters, and private groups into a single hub.
Dedicated Methodological Guides: Provides domain-specific markdown files to guide analysts on tooling usage for specific investigation types.
Vetted Third-Party Links: Maintains an active directory of external services, advising investigators to responsibly vet sources.

useCases.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence
useCases.description: Security analysts can quickly reference malware analysis and infrastructure tracking tools during active incident response.

useCases.title: Fraud Investigation
useCases.description: Financial investigators can utilize corporate intelligence and domain search tools for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) checks.

useCases.title: Physical Infrastructure Tracking
useCases.description: Researchers can correlate geospatial mapping with real-time aviation and vessel movement databases.

useCases.title: Digital Footprint Analysis
useCases.description: Investigators can utilize social media and email investigation links to map out phishing campaigns and digital identities.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Cyber threat intelligence analysts, fraud investigators, security researchers, and OSINT practitioners needing a structured and verified repository of investigative tools.
